iterations.note: The critic scored ITS OWN reconciliation text, the one arbitration selected and applied verbatim, and returned 7 rather than inflating it. arbitration_answers.q1: Load-bearing. Beat 7's only content beyond what beat 3 already gave is that Bauer converts hearing the tape at 03:14 into a confirmation. Beat 9 explicitly anchors on his two confirmations being 03:14 and 03:29, so if 03:14 is not a confirmation, beat 9 breaks with beat 7.
arbitration_answers.q3: This is an outline defect, not a draft defect. No draft can satisfy both the literal beat and the literal rule at once. The fix belongs in outline.md, not in the chapter.
